how_to_read: One entry per value of `t` in site/data/banners.json. Rates are starting rates in percent, taken from the rates box of real banner pages on the community wiki, each with the date of the page's last revision. null means not verified: print 'Check the rates on the banner's details screen' instead. `verified` refers to the rates. The free pick has its own flags (`who`: everyone, feh_pass, not_listed or null).

cost.text: A circle has five stones. First 5 orbs, then 4, 4, 4, 3: 20 orbs for all five. The first summon on every banner is free, and a First Summon Ticket also pays the first stone.

rate_rise.standard: Every five summons without a 5-star hero add 0.5% to the 5-star rate, split evenly between focus and other 5-star heroes (0.25% each). The raise is applied when the circle is finished, not inside it. After 120 summons without a 5-star, the next circle is all 5-star heroes.
rate_rise.standard_no_other: Same raise of 0.5% per five summons; on banners without other 5-star heroes all of it goes to the focus rate.
rate_rise.on_focus_5star: A 5-star focus hero sets the rate back to the start once the circle is closed.
rate_rise.on_4star: A 4-star focus or 4-star special rate hero changes nothing.
rate_rise.carry_over: The raise belongs to one banner and does not move to the next.

rate_rise.note: No source dated 2025 or 2026 with the full rules was found: the community wiki page is from 2022; the Fire Emblem Wiki page (edited Apr 2026) agrees on 0.5% and 120. `on_other_5star` is null because sources differ: the 2022 wiki page says the rate drops by 1% each for focus and other; the Fire Emblem Wiki still says it resets; no official text was found. Wording the sources share: 'A 5-star that is not a focus hero lowers the raise but does not remove it.' The `standard_no_other` line is from play experience, not from a source.

focus_charge.text: Each 5-star hero that is not a focus hero lights one of three charges. With three lit, the next circle draws its 5-star heroes from the focus heroes only (the other-5-star rate is added to the focus rate). It ends when a focus 5-star is summoned or the banner ends. A charge filled in the middle of a circle works from the next circle.
